category_title: Highly gifted African-American male masking ability for social acceptance
minimal_context: The tutor and student are in a one-on-one conversation reviewing the student's personal composition notebook.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am looking at the composition notebook you handed me. Let's review the writing and drawings you have on these first fifty pages.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shrugs) It's just some stuff I write on my own. Mostly just poems and things like that.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I see that it is highly structured and uses a lot of vocabulary.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yeah, well, I can't exactly do that in class. I learned pretty quick that it's uncool to be smart, so I just keep it in the notebook to stay good with my peers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The quality and depth of this work is very good.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Scoffs) Whatever. Having this ability is just a curse anyway. I know I'm underachieving in my classes, but it doesn't bother me. I don't need high achievements to validate who I am at the core.

task.content: Reviewing independent writing and drawing in a personal composition notebook that is highly structured and written with impeccable vocabulary and candor.

context.materials: Composition notebook brimming with writing and drawings on nearly the first fifty pages
context.social_setting: One-on-one conversation regarding academic performance and social identity

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Receiving positive comments regarding the quality or depth of his work
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Jimmy scoffed at positive comments regarding the quality or depth of his work.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Knew he was underachieving, but that it didn’t bother him because he didn’t need high achievements to validate who he was at the core; afraid of the risk required to get there.

behavior_patterns.condition: During a discussion about the potential benefits of high ability
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Views his high intellectual ability as a social liability.
